verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile ships Copilot chat. Users can ask it, in natural language, to explain code, give insights into public and private repositories, and open a new pull request. They can also start Copilot agent tasks, assign issues to Copilot and refine the resulting PRs through comments. All of this comes from the vendor marketing page, and the evidence shows natural-language action only for PR creation and agent tasks, not for operating the app broadly. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over other app actions (navigation, merging, triage), in-depth documentation beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
